page.overview:
Who is Alinka Aloo?

Lady Alinka Aloo, daughter of Imperial Adviser Sim Aloo, was a Coruscant-based collector of Sith artifacts who managed the Aloo family's affairs and undertook covert missions on Emperor Palpatine's behalf. Known for her cunning and ambition, she orchestrated a dangerous expedition to retrieve an ancient dark side book from Ushruu—recruiting Chewbacca, the captive librarian Mayvlin Trillick, and an unassuming cargo droid—only for the mission to unravel when the droid proved to be the Rebel agent K-2SO and the snarler creatures of Ushruu followed the team back to Coruscant, leaving Alinka empty-handed and outmaneuvered.

A human woman from Coruscant, Lady Alinka Aloo was and the daughter of Sim Aloo, from a second marriage. She held the rank of princess and was properly addressed either as "Your Highness" or "Lady Alinka." Together with her father, she assisted in acquiring Sith artifacts from across the galaxy for the Emperor's private collection, and she oversaw the Aloo family's business interests during her father's frequent absences. She resided in a tower situated on one of the highest levels of Imperial City.

At some point during the Imperial Era, Palpatine expressed interest in an ancient dark side tome kept within a temple on the planet Ushruu. Both Sim Aloo and fellow adviser Janus Greejatus sought to retrieve the artifact, though Greejatus's attempt—conducted hastily through a hired group of Trandoshan mercenaries—ended in failure when the team was devoured by Ushruu's native snarler creatures. Seeking to ensure her father's success, Alinka devised a more deliberate plan, determining that the mission required a Wookiee guide capable of navigating Ushruu's dense forests, a librarian to recover the book, and a cargo droid to transport it.

For the librarian, Alinka selected Mayvlin Trillick, an Oktarian youth apprehended while attempting to steal from one of Sim Aloo's warehouses. Alinka coerced Trillick's cooperation by withholding the Mola Oktaro, the most sacred text of the Oktaran people. She chose the Wookiee Chewbacca—co-pilot of the smuggler Han Solo—for his strength and familiarity with hazardous terrain. The cargo droid assignment fell to a K-2SB unit that volunteered for the mission, as the Aloos paid little attention to droid personnel.
